examples.label: Typical good client
examples.description: Didn't default and the model correctly cleared them (median such client).

examples.label: Caught defaulter
examples.description: Defaulted and the model flagged them (median such client).

examples.label: Most confident false alarm
examples.description: The highest-probability client who did NOT default (Section 10).

examples.label: Most confidently missed defaulter
examples.description: The lowest-probability client who DID default (Section 10).

examples.label: Borderline client
examples.description: Probability right at the r = 5 threshold, so moving the slider flips the prediction.

examples.label: Pays in full every month
examples.description: Repayment status is "paid in full" in all six months.

examples.label: Inactive card (no bills)
examples.description: No bill in any of the six months (Section 2: 836 such clients in the full data).

examples.label: Overpaid (negative September bill)
examples.description: Paid more than they owed, so the September balance is negative.

examples.label: Over the credit limit
examples.description: September bill is higher than the credit limit.

examples.label: Late only in September
examples.description: Paid on time from April to August, then fell behind in September.

examples.label: Was late, now caught up
examples.description: Late at some point in April-June, on time from July to September.

examples.label: Young, low credit limit
examples.description: Age 25 or under with a credit limit of at most 50,000 NT$.

examples.label: High limit, large balance
examples.description: Credit limit of at least 400,000 NT$ and a September bill of at least half of it.
